verdict.rationale: Square documents an official Mobile Payments SDK with platform-specific pages for iOS (Tap to Pay on iPhone) and Android (Offline Payments), which directly covers embedding in-person payments into a developer's own iOS or Android app. The evidence is mostly page titles and URLs rather than substantive SDK content. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the SDK integration flow and card reader/hardware support, plus independent or hands-on developer corroboration.
